children: Overview
US apparel retailer's fiscal Q2 revenue rose 8%, slightly beating analyst expectations
EPS for fiscal Q2 rose to $0.79, boosted by tariff refund benefit
Aerie and OFFLINE revenue grew 25%, while American Eagle comparable sales fell 1%
Outlook
Company sees Q3 comparable sales rising mid-to-high single digits
American Eagle Outfitters expects full-year operating income of $540 mln to $550 mln
Company expects full-year comparable sales to increase mid-single digits
Q3 gross margin guided flat YoY, with SG&A up high-single digits, signaling less tariff-related tailwind ahead
Result Drivers
TARIFF REFUNDS - Net benefit from tariff refunds significantly boosted gross profit and operating income in Q2
AERIE AND OFFLINE GROWTH - Strong performance at Aerie and OFFLINE drove overall revenue and comparable sales growth
AMERICAN EAGLE BRAND SOFTNESS - American Eagle comparable sales declined 1%, with improvement in men's offset by weakness in women's
